title: Documentation Policy
summary: Canonical JSON documentation policy for Rig Relay. New docs must be JSON. Old Markdown must be migrated before deletion.

title: Agent Loop Boundary
summary: Defines the AgentLoop turn/session conductor boundary: what it owns, what it delegates, allowed and forbidden dependencies, and how new runtime components are added.

title: Orchestrator Loop Boundary
summary: Ownership doctrine for Rig Relay runtimes: who may run a full turn loop, 7 principles governing OrchestratorLoop, ConversationRuntime, SubagentRuntime, RalphRuntime, ToolRuntime, and handoff receipts.

title: Storage Retention Policy
summary: Retention policy for local Rig Relay storage including sessions, artifacts, telemetry, and traces.

title: Test Suite Doctrine
summary: Governance doctrine for Rig Relay's 6,500+ test suite covering layout, parametrization, test quality taxonomy, and lifecycle management.

title: ToolRuntime Boundary
summary: Defines ToolRuntime as the governed tool execution authority. Ownership, capability boundaries, layered execution model, and separation from Ralph, desktop HITL, and analytics compiler.

title: Tracing Doctrine
summary: Rig Relay tracing is structured runtime evidence using spans, events, and redacted attributes. Not random logging.
